description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

How tank crews endured cramped steel boxes that smelled like a sewer in WWII. No room to stand, oil-fuel-sweat haze, 100°F+ heat, no bathrooms, and constant dehydration made armored life brutal.

The tank was built for firepower—not comfort. Living inside it was punishment.
